services.name: Dolphin & Shelling  Adventure Island Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a leisurely 2 hour cruise down the Anclote River into the Gulf. Our Master Naturalist will narrate your trip and highlight local wildlife, including dolphins, sea turtles, eagles, water birds and tropical foliage. The cruise will stop at Anclote Key where you will disembark for approx. 30 minutes. You can view the lighthouse, stroll the beach, look for shells or even take a dip in our beautiful Gulf. If you prefer to stay on the boat and not wander the beach please select the Dolphin Cruise Duration 2 Hours Other Information: The Dolphin Adventure Island Cruise includes a stop at Anclote Island where you will be able to depart the boat and explore the Island. services.name: Sunset Cruise - Dolphin & Shelling Adventure Island Cruise
services.desc: The Odyssey Sunset Cruise is a magnificent way to celebrate the end of another day in paradise. Bring your camera to capture our marvelous Gulf Sunset. Your 2 hour cruise will take you down the Anclote River into the Gulf of Mexico. Our Master Naturalist will narrate your trip. You will learn about our local wildlife and the history of Tarpon Springs/Sponge Docks. The cruise will disembark on Anclote Key. You will have time to walk the beach and enjoy the beautiful sunset. You can put your toes in the Gulf and pick up a few seashells. services.name: Island Time Tour
services.desc: Spend hours on Anclote Key! Our 40 foot Sightseer will drop you off on the beach, and remain within wading distance so you can enjoy a beverage (included in price) or use the restroom. 4 hours on the beach for weekday trips, 3 hours on the beach for weekend trips! What to bring: Snacks and lunch Swimwear Beach gear Birding binoculars Your camera for close-ups of the Anclote Lighthouse! Requirements: Must be in good physical condition and able to climb a small ladder onto boat. services.name: 4th of July Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: Join us for a special Independence Day celebration on our 4th of July fireworks cruise. This is the ONLY way to watch the fireworks! No traffic, no rushing, no headaches. We are taking a special 3 hour cruise to Anclote Key for 30 minutes, then into the Gulf to see a breathtaking sunset, and then watch the fireworks show. Of course we will also look for the dolphins, manatees, and other local wildlife during the cruise. Duration 3 Hours What to Bring For your pleasure and convenience, we offer cold beverages, beer, wine, margaritas and other tropical drinks on board.
